profile.headline: Senior Online Software Engineer at Electronic Arts (EA)

positions.title: Lead Server Software Engineer
positions.description:
I developed an action MO RPG named Kingdom Under Fire 2 as a main server programmer.
I designed and made all about the server and DB.
Server was running on Windows, multi-threaded, 64bit-based, and using IOCP.
The first closed beta test ended in success.
but I decided to change my job, since the company’s situation was getting worse and they were not able to pay monthly salary.

positions.title: Senior Server Software Engineer
positions.description:
After that, I joined Nexon to develop a casual shooting game, Trash Buster, as a main server programmer.
At the time, they just finished the second Closed-Beta Test, but the result was bad.
So I joined, redesigned and remade the server and DB.
I also designed client synchronization and reliable UDP with client programmers.
The game was shipped, but the result was not good. So I moved to another team.
 
The next game was a Social Network Game called Nexon Star.
I made client and server logic for its quest system.
But I quit the job to start my own business for iphone.

positions.title: Lead Server Software Engineer
positions.description:
I participated in developing Gotcha Man Online as a main server programmer.
I architected the overall structure of server, and designed P2P logic-flows, DB Tables, and DB-stored procedures.
The server was multi-threaded using IOCP, My-SQL for DBMS, and SVN for VCS.
I also had to develop various tools because the company was small. The tools are GMTool, Item Exporter, String Exporter, and DB Connect Info File.
But as they were not able to pay monthly salary, I had to change my job.

positions.title: Server Software Engineer
positions.description:
I maintained servers of the JAE MI System board games for Japan and China services after M&A.
After few fonths, I developed the server for a new casual game, but it was dropped, and I moved to FreeStyle localization team.
FreeStyle is online basketball game. It was using P2P hole punching for client communication.
But to graduate my university, I decided to move to another company that allowed me to do so.

positions.title: Server Software Engineer
positions.description:
I joined JAE MI System to develop severs for SEGA LINK’s casual games like Majong, Bakara, Poker, and etc..
I also developed ther server of Poyo Poyo Online of SEGA, but unfortunately it was dropped. All the servers were running on Windows, and multi-threaded using IOCP.
DBMS was MS-SQL and version control system was SourceSafe.
As JAE MI System got merged into JC Entertainment, I also moved in to the company.

positions.title: Server Software Engineer
positions.description:
I joined SYRELL to develop and maintain the server of Roomz, which is an MMORPG.
The server was running on Linux(Redhat) and single-thread-based.
I debugged .Core files using GDB.
DBMS was MySQL and Version control system was CVS.
I also maintained servers in IDC because this company was too small to have server engineers.
But I had to change my job as the company’s situation got worse.
